linkedin: Collectors know the feeling: you're standing in your favourite charity shop, vinyl in hand, and—wait. Do I already own this? Seconds later, you're home realizing you've bought a duplicate for the third time this month. Frustrating. Expensive. Avoidable. SeniorEase is built for exactly this moment. A simple barcode scanner that lives on your phone—no cloud, no account, no monthly fees. Just €4.99, once. Scan before you buy. Know what's already on your shelf. Your collection data stays on your device, completely private. For collectors aged 45–75 who've built impressive libraries (300+ items) and deserve better than subscription bloat or cloud dependency. SeniorEase respects your collection and your privacy. Curious? Visit seniorease.eu and see how collectors are taking back control. #Collectors #PrivacyFirst #NoMoreDuplicates
